ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the legend shows that dotted filling indicates residential area, cross-hatching indicates industrial area, diagonal hatching indicates science and technology area, and there are also traffic symbols such as roads and railway passenger stations. Point No. 1 in the figure is located inside the dotted residential area in the middle-right part of the city and is close to roads; the industrial areas are mainly distributed on the periphery and are at a certain distance from Point No. 1. Then reason: the question requires the layout of a hospital. The site selection of a hospital should facilitate serving residents, have convenient transportation and a relatively good environment, and be as far as possible from industrial pollution. Point No. 1 is located within the residential area and near roads, and best meets the requirements for hospital site selection.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：依据图例确定各功能区，确认1号点落在点状生活区内部且靠近道路。再读题确定要布局的是“医院”。运用医院选址原则——服务居民、交通便利、环境较好、远离工业污染——将1号与医院需求匹配，得出最适宜地点为1。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图例显示，点状填充表示生活区，交叉网纹表示工业区，斜线纹表示科技区，另有公路、铁路客运站等交通符号。图中1号点位于城市中部偏右的点状生活区内部，并且靠近道路；工业区主要分布在外围，与1号点有一定距离。再推理：题目要求布局医院。医院选址应便于服务居民、交通便利、环境较好，并尽量远离工业污染。1号点位于生活区内且近道路，最符合医院选址要求。
